items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: That's one of the mysteries of the Boyd Raeburn Band. ... Years later he became the manager. ... Hy Mandel is a rather bad saxophone player; I've always felt he was terrible, yet in that band he played his part

ctx.x: musician and a marvelous human being. A terrific guy.
That's one of the mysteries of the Boyd Raeburn Band.
